description: This file contains the Ext JS 3.4.0 library code, including core functions, class extensions, DOM and event utilities, and region calculations, with a focus on the Ext object and its methods.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Region
classes.description: Represents a rectangular region with methods for containment, intersection, union, and constraints.

classes.name: Ext.lib.Point
classes.description: Represents a point with x and y coordinates, extending Ext.lib.Region for region-based calculations.

methods.name: Ext.apply
methods.description: Copies properties from source objects to a target object.

methods.name: Ext.applyIf
methods.description: Copies properties from source to target only if they are undefined in the target.

methods.name: Ext.extend
methods.description: Creates a subclass of a class with inheritance.

methods.name: Ext.getDom
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element from an id or element.

methods.name: Ext.get
methods.description: Retrieves an Ext.Element wrapper for a DOM element.
